header.name: [bedrock-research]hud-expression-cost-bp_v1.0.0
header.description: v1.0.0 - Sends a new HUD title every tick with 64 item cells in the subtitle while the HUD Expression Cost item is held, to compare one shared cell expression with per-cell fixed expressions at 64, 256 and 512 cells. Use the item to switch modes.
